lxc_a7bb157c6bdc7b7a.text: You will learn how Tokyo Gas Yamanashi is connected to the main Tokyo Gas group and how to research an internship offer.

lxc_4eccc290258759ca.text: You will also prepare clear, polite questions about the department, daily work, mentor, and parent company.

lxc_88990fc423cf785d.text: When one company owns another company, we use two words.

lxc_f9f772523e628c10.text: The big one is the parent company.

lxc_88a8c3092e1a9c72.text: The smaller one is a subsidiary.

lxc_6b657ad2ae832d2f.text: In Japanese, people say oyagaisha for the parent and kogaisha for the subsidiary.

lxc_2eed2cda9d25349e.text: A subsidiary is not just a branch office.

lxc_e1f93ff1807b90e3.text: It is a real company with its own name, its own offices, and its own staff.

lxc_236f9c7770c7d2d6.text: The parent company owns shares of the subsidiary, so it has power over big decisions.

lxc_08b307e9aa8a1b30.text: But the daily work happens inside the subsidiary.

lxc_f63741dd3a796e7b.text: Japanese business people also use the word 'group company' or gurūpu-gaisha.

lxc_2bc66a44b6788785.text: This means a company in the same family of businesses.

lxc_400702ef00809116.text: So when your son gets an offer from Tokyo Gas Yamanashi, this is important.

lxc_927ce0c8529f261f.text: It is a group company of Tokyo Gas.

lxc_ace9f619adb65157.text: It is not the same office as Tokyo Gas in the capital.

lxc_4625ccbca892b029.text: It has its own team in Yamanashi Prefecture.

lxc_a450a9925eb91ccb.text: It was founded in 1885, more than 130 years ago.

lxc_04fb819e97254673.text: It is one of the largest city gas companies in Japan.

lxc_9adf29ddec0ae961.text: It serves the Tokyo area, including Tokyo, Kanagawa, Chiba, Saitama, and some other places nearby.

lxc_9f8c0d07cac4f48e.text: Millions of homes and many factories use its city gas.

lxc_cda41aed2ae0c463.text: Inside the Tokyo Gas group, there is also a company called Tokyo Gas Network.

lxc_1466474cce498c21.text: This company manages the pipelines under the streets.

lxc_5e504c242cbb4e76.text: In Japan, the law now separates the gas pipes from the gas sales.

lxc_82b6c1dfe104b379.text: So one company sells the gas, and another company takes care of the pipes.

lxc_892c2530e7822e7d.text: It is very big and well known.

lxc_7a7d6b087a1c72dc.text: But remember: the offer for your son is not from this main company.

lxc_fc6a5df49122f808.text: It is from a smaller group company in Yamanashi.

lxc_6fc924925b08644d.text: Tokyo Gas Yamanashi is the regional group company for Yamanashi Prefecture.

lxc_cdb54bf1ebbc8817.text: It is owned by Tokyo Gas, so Tokyo Gas is the parent company.

lxc_1e4ac806dec73c5f.text: But Tokyo Gas Yamanashi has its own office, its own workers, and its own customers in Yamanashi.

lxc_86b2d2c46693d3f1.text: It handles two kinds of gas.

lxc_2fe7b45d9280fc04.text: First, city gas: gas that comes to homes through pipes in the towns.

lxc_80b83dc2c89600ce.text: Second, LPG, also called propane gas.

lxc_358c9b40f79998d9.text: LPG is sold in tanks and is common in mountain areas and small villages where there are no gas pipes.

lxc_80e90f5135301a3c.text: Yamanashi has many small towns and mountain areas, so both kinds of gas are needed.

lxc_649ef3d133cd17cc.text: This company is much smaller than the main Tokyo Gas in the capital, but the work is still real and important.

lxc_b7952772aaec205a.text: If your son works here as an intern, he will see gas service in a countryside area, not in a big city.

lxc_1d0695246955c1a8.text: Here are simple steps to research the internship.

lxc_630516d101644a3b.text: First, take the offer letter and write down the exact legal company name.

lxc_b10aa19549cc2f5e.text: It is important to copy it exactly, because 'Tokyo Gas' and 'Tokyo Gas Yamanashi' are not the same company.

lxc_b0dc0c5ae08701a0.text: Second, search online for that exact company's official website.

lxc_d5bfd6573bf63895.text: Be careful: some search results are old articles or copies.

lxc_378ce81a86eba23b.text: Look for the real, official site.

lxc_65c962924e28f392.text: Third, open the company overview page.

lxc_c3e0d00d926e62dc.text: In Japanese this is called kaisha gaiyō.

lxc_b878e7ad28ae56ad.text: This page shows the address, the number of workers, the year the company started, and the main business.

lxc_0627022889b0a853.text: Fourth, check who the parent company is.

lxc_f4490efe4f486b87.text: The overview page usually says this clearly.

lxc_964f622484948740.text: Fifth, read what the internship program covers: how many days, what tasks, and what the intern will learn.

lxc_ce66ad0e1ef90a58.text: Also prepare questions to ask: which department will he join, what does a normal day look like, and who will be his mentor.

lxc_5ec1c11791c9c175.text: In the end, a famous name matters less than what your son will really see, learn, and practice every day.
